title: Stockton, CA — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Stockton, CA: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Stockton is a city in CA with a population of 320,804. Central Valley port city with waterfront revival, cheaper than Bay Area but still California prices. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. A relatively small share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 257 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively high. The population skews young, with a median age of 33.7.
